init_logger_setup: init a logger with stdout and stderr handlers using LogFormatter for distributed training jobs
init_logger_with_file: init a logger that writes logs to a file on rank 0 using an optional fsspec filesystem
set_root_log_level: set the root logger level to a string like DEBUG or an integer value
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that adds rank, level name, timestamp, and elapsed time to log messages
review_log_formatter_multiline: review the LogFormatter class to understand how it indents multiline log messages and exception tracebacks
